Simulated fc is 841 kHz, about 11% below the window, so the OTA's finite gain and bandwidth are pulling the cutoff down. The two tail devices are also at the edge of saturation. The topology is fine, so this is a numerical refinement. Raising Itail and Win increases OTA gain and lowers the input Vgs, which gives the tail more Vds. kf is widened to absorb the remaining fc shortfall, and power stays under budget.
